verdict.rationale: Parsec documents its own Teams API for automating deployment, pulling full audit logs, and reporting (parsec-docs-22, parsec-docs-23, parsec-docs-24). That is a first-party API, but its stated scope is narrow administrative automation, not parity with everything the UI can do. It is also limited to Teams/Enterprise tiers, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or machine-readable API docs (parsec-probe-2, parsec-probe-3). Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for core UI actions such as connecting, session sharing, guest permissions and computer assignment; a published API reference or OpenAPI spec; API access for non-Teams users; independent corroboration of API completeness.
